results.title: The Little Sister
results.overview: When Fatima leaves her close-knit suburban family to study philosophy in Paris, she finds herself caught between her religious upbringing and the freedom of student life in the city.

results.title: A Christmas Angel Match
results.overview: Christmas angels used to working alone to bring “destined soulmates together” over the holidays, are unexpectedly paired; soon, their “clashing styles – and the undeniable spark growing between them – complicate their mission.”

results.title: A Copenhagen Love Story
results.overview: After author Mia finds love with single father Emil, their happiness is put to the test as they undergo fertility treatments to have kids of their own.

results.title: Valiente: A Tracker Story
results.overview: Tracker and Carlos come across a series of nocturnal animals fleeing the Shadow Jungle. Tracker, with the help from Ryder and the PAW Patrol, must brave his fear of the dark and stop a new villain, Lucita Mala.

results.title: Trainwreck: The Real Project X
results.overview: A night of drunken chaos rocks a quiet Dutch town in this shocking documentary about a teen's birthday invite that accidentally went viral on Facebook.

results.title: I am Taiwanese
results.overview: The film, which took five years to make and was initiated by Senate President Vystrčil's visit to Taiwan in 2020, maps the current geopolitical situation of this island nation and seeks not only historical but mainly current parallels between Taiwan's position vis-à-vis China and Russia's position vis-à-vis smaller countries, including Ukraine, the Baltic states, and even the Czech Republic. China's pressure on Taiwan is intensifying, and this island state is increasingly under threat. Will it maintain its freedom and independence in today's complex world, where conflicts are on the rise and, with the possible help of the democratic world, it is becoming increasingly complicated?

results.title: Rogue Wave
results.overview: Eve and Tris build a machine that transforms sound into pure euphoria.  As their invention gains fame, Tris's growing addiction threatens to destroy their partnership and unleash dangerous consequences.

results.title: Bloody Trip: Rise of the Dead
results.original_title: Bloody Trip: Rise of the Dead

results.title: Mile 666
results.overview: Fleeing her past, a troubled hiker and her dog traverse the Appalachian Trail, only to fall under the spell of a dangerous man. As obsession and visions mount, she's drawn toward Mile 666, where lust, death, and something ancient await.

results.title: Love and Wine
results.overview: A privileged young man working at his wealthy father's business traps himself in a lie when he falls in love with a hard-working medical student, and tries to convince her that he comes from more humble beginnings like hers. What follows is a comedic whirlwind of chaos and heartfelt revelations.

results.title: Cuentos Vol. I - El Grano que Construyó el Mundo

results.title: The Dread
results.overview: After having her entire life uprooted by moving to a new city, a young woman begins hearing strange sounds and experiencing terrifying visions. Is her house haunted? Or is it something more sinister?

results.title: The Meeting
results.overview: A first responder attends a survivor's guilt meeting in hopes of making sense of a recent tragedy.

results.title: The Roughneck
results.overview: An oil worker and his dog embark on a journey to his wedding, but after a violent attack at a rest stop, he teams with his ex-convict father to seek revenge, uncovering dark secrets in their rural community.

results.title: First Moon
results.overview: A young waitress is abducted by a religious cult, who are hell-bent on curing her from a sexually transmitted werewolf virus - or killing her in the process. Will she escape before the first full moon?

results.title: Enzo
results.overview: Enzo, 16, defies his bourgeois family’s expectations by starting a masonry apprenticeship, a path far removed from the prestigious life they had envisioned for him. In their chic villa in the sun-drenched South of France, tensions simmer as relentless questions and pressures weigh on Enzo’s future and dreams. On the construction sites, however, Vlad, a charismatic Ukrainian colleague, shakes up Enzo’s world and opens the door to unexpected possibilities.

results.title: Two Seasons, Two Strangers
results.overview: In summer, Nagisa and Natsuo meet by the sea. Their vacant gazes reflect each other as they exchange awkward words and wade into the rain-drenched ocean. In winter, Li, a screenwriter, travels to a snow-covered village. There, she finds a guesthouse run by Benzo.

results.title: Secret Magic Control Agency 2
results.overview: Agents Hansel and Gretel undergo their most important mission yet. In a race against the clock, the agents must work together to save a princess from her enchanted slumber. But when they cross paths with a sorcery-wielding Prince who is after the same prize, Gretel finds herself battling the most powerful force she's ever experienced... true love.

results.title: White Guilt
results.overview: Eleven affluent white individuals in their twenties and thirties embark on a journey aboard a bus, seeking to assuage their white guilt through a pay-to-play service.
